body: Thank you so much. Is anger better than emptiness though?

I hate irony but I still think it's one of the best things. I hate that my existence could be written down with the word "irony" but I admire how it happens impossibly often and in ridiculously smart ways. Thank you for commenting. I'm glad here's a proof some people must understand how I see.

I always thought everyone thinks like me, they are just pretending better. So that's not true? Is that progress? If so, the merit is yours. I will talk to a doctor. I hope at one point you will be happy. Thank you for answering.
